# ADDENDUM TO THE BIDDING DOCUMENT FOR THE PROVISION OF CATERING SERVICES AT VARIOUS URA STATIONS
PROC REF NO: URA/NCON/CSD/25-26/03429
ADDENDUM TO THE BIDDING DOCUMENT FOR THE PROVISION OF CATERING SERVICES AT VARIOUS URA STATIONS UNDER FRAMEWORK CONTRACT ARRANGEMENT AT MASAKA DT, SOROTI DT, RR PEARL TOWER, ELEGU CUSTOMS STATION, IBANDA DT, NEBBI DT, KYOTERA DT, KAGADI DT, KISORO DT, BWEYALE AND KAYUNGA .
Reference is made to the adverts that appeared in the Daily Monitor of Tuesday, April 28, 2026 and New Vision of Thursday, April 23, 2026. This is to inform all interested parties that the Bidding document has been revised as below;
PREVIOUS REQUIREMENTS
ADDENDUM
Provision of Catering Services at Various URA Stations under Framework Contract Arrangement at Masaka DT, Soroti DT, RR Pearl Tower, Elegu Customs Station, Ibanda DT, Nebbi DT, Kyotera DT, Kagadi DT, Kisoro DT, Bweyale and Kayunga
Inclusion of provision of Staff Lunch at Masindi DT and Suam River OSBP within the scope of stations covered under the procurement.
Bid Submission Deadline Friday 15 th May, 2026 at 10:00am
Friday 29 th May, 2026 at 10:00am.
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
